name: movscript
description: MovScript project, script, workspace, media query, and generation tools backed by the frontend MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use MovScript projects, scripts, workspaces, media queries, and generation.
interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript project/script/workspace guidance and connects to the MovScript frontend MCP server. The MCP bridge exposes current focus, project listing and creation, script listing, script passage location, workspace files, project queries, MovScript resource-library search, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, image generation, video generation, job polling, and candidate attachment. Workspace review/apply remains a UI boundary.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MovScript's MCP tools for current focus, project/script context, resource-library lookup, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, image/video generation, and workspace edits. Treat generation input_resource_ids/reference_resource_ids as MovScript RawResource IDs only, and keep review/apply handoff in the MovScript UI.
